localChanges: With civ.one's own pixel art, on the square, hexagonal and isometric maps, Farmland shows rows of ripe wheat between its irrigation channels, an Airbase a runway, hangar and windsock, and a Fortress its palisade (closes #1243).

log: The square, hexagonal and isometric packs draw Farmland (wheat between the irrigation channels) and an Airbase (runway, hangar and windsock), and declare the existing fort as the Fortress, for civ-clone/web-renderer#1243.
